bagPolicy.summary: Standard-size backpacks are tolerated and paid lockers are available in the lobby; large backpacks and suitcases cannot enter the performance hall.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Philharmonie Q-Park garage is about a five-minute walk away, with entrance at 185 boulevard Sérurier.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general rideshare pickup location for concerts; consult the event instructions.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue sells hot dogs, burgers and other food and beverages in its lobby.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Wheelchair seating is provided on raised platforms reached by a dedicated lift; accessible restrooms and counters are available.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not allowed. Once you leave, you cannot come back in, even with early entry or VIP tickets.

ticketPickup.summary: Official ticket sellers are linked on each event page. You do not need to print your ticket; show the QR code or barcode on your digital ticket. Tickets are not always sold on site.

gates.summary: Doors usually open 90 minutes before the show start printed on the ticket.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
